question: When difference between compound and simple interest for three years is ₹93 at 10% interest per annum, the principal is ₹____________.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective Simple Interest (SI) for 3 years at 10% = 10% × 3 = 30%

Effective Compound Interest (CI) for 3 years at 10% = 33.1%

Difference in interest rates = 33.1% − 30% = 3.1%

Given 3.1% of Principal = ₹93

Principal (100%) = (93 ÷ 3.1) × 100 = ₹3000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹3000.**
